summary: 25-year-old hiker fell and was pulled underwater at West Creek Falls in Rocky Mountain National Park; died; body recovered that evening; helitack to Upper Beaver Meadows; transferred to the Larimer County Coroner.
location: West Creek Falls, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Run-927 merge: NPS release (parent-opened) — confirms 2023-07-02 Sunday, 25-YO Providence RI male pulled underwater at West Creek Falls, Northern Colorado Interagency Helitak body flight to Upper Beaver Meadows; park assisted by LCSO, Estes Park Health, Estes Park PD, Estes Valley Crisis Advocates.
